q: What was the finance P&L net profit for September 2026 as booked by event date, and how does it differ from the order-date net profit?
answer:
The finance (P&L, event-date) net profit for Sep 2026 was a loss of ₹1,508,358; on the order-date basis net profit was a loss of ₹207,191 — the P&L (event-date) loss is ₹1,301,167 larger (more negative) than the order-date loss.

- What changed: P&L net profit (finance P&L, event date) = ₹-1,508,358 vs net profit (order date) = ₹-207,191 for 2026-09-01..2026-09-30. The event-date P&L shows a substantially bigger loss (₹1,301,167 worse).
- Why it matters: order-date nets keep revenue and some costs on the order date; the P&L (event date) books returns, cancellations and some cost timings when they post, so the books show a deeper loss for September. Use the P&L view when you need finance/booked results; use order-date when analysing orders or marketing efficiency by purchase date.
